asr.full_text: We all have some luck to have someone who has never tried Rajpur Bhajiya Today's recipe will be about how to make this at home So let's start the recipe I'm Suhetal, welcome to Kitchen Craft There are three types of recipe in Rajpur Bhajiya Batak Vada, Batak Bha bhaja & Methi na gota Today we are making all these 3 2 are made of 2 large beans and 2 of them are of small quantity And 1 cup of fenugreek leaves First, we will make the stuffing of Methi gota I have taken 3-4th cup Gram Flour The gram flour in the packaging is already used so I am using 3 fourth cup of sugar so it means we are using the ready packet of sugar and another 1 fourth cup of soji and you can use any soji of your choice we have to mix both soji together if you do not have soji, you can add some hot buttermilk but if you are waiting for perfect result then use the soji the buttermilk we use at home since it is no longer smooth And that's how, the prepared gram flour is added now As much rice and soji you drink, add 1 cup fenugreek seeds Take your measurement as shown and add 2-3 tsp red chilly powder measurement with the ingredients given 3 tsp red chilly paste these paste of seeds are slightly spicy, that's why i am adding a little more if you want spice in it, then reduce the paste It is not added to this bhajiya because of its own sour taste But if you require it After rinsing the Fenugreek seeds with water, mix well and pour in water Once mix is done, add 1 fourth cup of Water mix well usually while making methi gonta we should keep consistency thin so add the weight of the Water in this way when making methi gonta, in general we take 2 part of Rice at the time of both of them When it comes to this dough make sure to get atleast a 1-2 keep the consistency of kh khira has to be, like this so, we do not add water to it Add Salt to taste Make sure you add Salt as before so you don't add more I have added less than 1 1⁄2 tsp salt in this case Mix well Once Mix is done we'll let it rest for about 15 to 20 mins mix thoroughly wait so that Soji forms for 15-20 mins for 2 cups of Bhataka Vada and 2 cups of Bhatakana Bhajiya Take 1 cup of Bhasana So no need of whole gram flour Add water to the pan and prepare a khiru Break the mix from the ground soya milk powder Try to take a texture of khiru Keep small particles of the mixture Mix with a beater Add water little by little and make a dough ball If you don't have a mould to this dough ball, it won't be smooth For this, you can add more water if you don't have a mould I am using little amount of water But this is not necessary, I have added 1 more ball for this one If you want to use extra quantity of dough You can start making aheer for both ingredients Kheer is ready and now I will add salt as per taste In this case I am adding less than 1.5 tsp salt once all the Kheer is cooked properly then we will make the batter for Bataka Vada I have heated 3 spoons of oil in a nonstick pan Put 1-1.5 tsp Cumin seeds and 1-1.5 tsp Mustard seeds Keep the flame at low When the Cumin & Cumin seeds get well mashed, add 1-1.5 tsp whole corns Add a little Hing Add 10-12 sweet lemon leaves 1⁄4 tsp Turmeric Powder Mix everything well Now let's add urad dal marja paste and the mixture is done Time to add the Baking Powder and the White Pepper Paste I have added two spoon white pepper paste and only half spoon of baking powder I added 6 red chilies to the same paste Add the right kind of the Chilli as per your preference The paste of this paste we have to marinate it for 1 to 1.5 minutes After that we will mash Bafele in this manner Now adding salt according to the taste I have added 1tsp of salt Adding ½ tsp Garam Masala Add 1 tsp sugar Add 1 1⁄2 tsp Garam Masala Add 1 1⁄2 tsp mango powder If you don't have Mango powder, add just lemongrass Add the lime juice to make the mango powder loose Add 1 tbsp Khand To test whether the crumb is getting tender or not add Amchur powder Add 1 spoon Khand Add 1 spoon from the mix in order to add some sweetening substance Since the bitter gourd has less sweetness so I am adding only 1 spoon but you may add upto 2-3 spoons for more sourness Add 1 cup Coriander Leaves You can add as much as 3 spoons as needed Now let's add coriander leaves With this quantity you can make 6-7 baddaka vadas with medium sized Mix the coriander properly and then turn off the gas And let it cool down completely Now that is cool down completely once it gets completely cooled so now let us prepare medium-sized fatakavada dough you can make these kind of dough according to your personal taste once the fatakavada dough is ready let us start making fatakas bhajiya take a strainer so from it For this let's prepare a slice of Bhataka To make Bhataka we will need to remove skin Remove the upper part to make the similar size slice We would need to cut a thick slice into it Usually we cut thin slices But the Bhataka we get in Raipur Bhajia have a thicker slices Like this we will find the Vataka in the Rajpur. So we make small thick slices and cut it in half. and then we will add it with some water to prevent the sligh from getting darker. I have made both the Vataka slices. Once the slices are ready, we will have some soda in a glass. Then will add a pinch of baking soda to it. We just mix everything thoroughly. Before adding the baking soda, let me do the heat up. So firstly, we will start frying the Batakah Vada . After heating up the oil properly, we will keep the gas flame medium and very high And we have to fry the Bataka Firstly, we will fry the Bataka After that in the same way we are going to prepare the fenugreek seeds After that after one side it gets fried Then we have to flip it If Bataka gets fried, it will break So we fry a little bit Then we are going to flip it If you keep stirring it for a longer period of time, theaitu or any other dish The first thing to step apart is to do so that the hot oil in the pan does not turn too hot and it does not become too thick Bhatak Vada is already fried , so now we will take it out I have prepared 6 Bhatak Vada of this size Now we will make Bhataka Bhjia In a pot, addya Add a little Soji to Kheera The one we get in Raypur bhajiya have Soji in it So, we will add Soji here to the Kheera and add some more soji to bring sweetness to Kheera Now, make sure that the mixture does not mix with the buttermilk mixture in the batter. When you make the batter like this, pour little amount of water in the container after pouring the batter into the container. in this fashion let it rest for 10 minutes after 10 minutes let's prepare the bhatak bhajiya let it rest for 10 minutes heat oil on medium flame as we have kept the bhatak slices hard it will take little more time to fry the bhatak We will fry these fritters for a little longer than the remaining space. If you fry it in very hot oil, then the paratha will have enough of the time to cook itself. But this is the case if the paratha is in some way dry then cook it in medium high heat. When these fritters become slightly wilted I will turn it aside. These fritters will take around 4-5 minutes to fry So if you wanna make this fritter in bigger quantity put a whistle in cooker and have it half boil After that slice it thick Then make fritters in larger quantity So you won't need more time once it is boiled, you have to slice it thickly and prepare the fry then you won't need more time to prepare the fry so, if you have large quantity then you can make fry this way after frying, then we will remove it and like this we will prepare other fillings now we will prepare the fenugreekta we need to fry whole coriander leaves then add some garam paste we have to add in 2-3 pinch of bhajiya keep the pan warm put on a pan and add little soda we will cook for few minutes before frying the bhajiya fry them with 1 tbsp oil for making the meat balls Because our meat balls will become bitter if we fry the meat balls so we need to fry 4-5 bhajiyas Heat a pan and put the meat ball on the other side and put the meat ball slightly on the handle When we prepare the meat ball, the consistency of it should be slightly thin remove mould from hand and make the mouth round to make fenugreek flat the consistency is still little thin and round shape so keep them in refilled oil and fry them once one side is fried flip it it will fried in 3-4 minutes let it steam for 3-4 minutes In our local Gota, some people add some salt for sweetness but here I am not adding any salt So if you wish to have some taste of Raypoor food then leave the Kheer without adding salt after 3 to 4 minutes we can now take it out its not required when fry the jaggery fry them on medium flame for 3 to 4 minutes the consistency should be crispy on the outside now our homemade Batak Vada , Methi Gota and Bataka Bhajiya are ready It is a really tasty Toi and you don't need any other chutney or ketchup I have added it in just to go along with Marjani If you follow the recipe from the beginning And cook the dish then their taste will change So try this recipe Comment segments.text: We all have some luck to have someone who has never tried Rajpur Bhajiya
Today's recipe will be about how to make this at home
So let's start the recipe
I'm Suhetal, welcome to Kitchen Craft
There are three types of recipe in Rajpur Bhajiya
Batak Vada, Batak Bha bhaja & Methi na gota
Today we are making all these 3
2 are made of 2 large beans and 2 of them are of small quantity
And 1 cup of fenugreek leaves
First, we will make the stuffing of Methi gota
I have taken 3-4th cup Gram Flour
The gram flour in the packaging is already used so I am using 3 fourth cup of sugar so it means we are using the ready packet of sugar
and another 1 fourth cup of soji
and you can use any soji of your choice
we have to mix both soji together
if you do not have soji, you can add some hot buttermilk
but if you are waiting for perfect result
then use the soji
the buttermilk we use at home since it is no longer smooth
And that's how, the prepared gram flour is added now
As much rice and soji you drink, add 1 cup fenugreek seeds
Take your measurement as shown and add 2-3 tsp red chilly powder measurement with the ingredients given
3 tsp red chilly paste
these paste of seeds are slightly spicy, that's why i am adding a little more
if you want spice in it, then reduce the paste
It is not added to this bhajiya because of its own sour taste
But if you require it
After rinsing the Fenugreek seeds with water, mix well and pour in water
Once mix is done, add 1 fourth cup of Water mix well
usually while making methi gonta
we should keep consistency thin
so add the weight of the Water in this way
when making methi gonta, in general we take 2 part of Rice
at the time of both of them When it comes to this dough make sure to get atleast a 1-2
keep the consistency of kh khira has to be, like this so, we do not add water to it
Add Salt to taste
Make sure you add Salt as before
so you don't add more
I have added less than 1 1⁄2 tsp salt
in this case
Mix well
Once Mix is done we'll let it rest for about 15 to 20 mins mix thoroughly
wait so that Soji forms for 15-20 mins
for 2 cups of Bhataka Vada and 2 cups of Bhatakana Bhajiya
Take 1 cup of Bhasana So no need of whole gram flour
Add water to the pan and prepare a khiru
Break the mix from the ground soya milk powder
Try to take a texture of khiru Keep small particles of the mixture
Mix with a beater
Add water little by little and make a dough ball
If you don't have a mould to this dough ball, it won't be smooth
For this, you can add more water if you don't have a mould
I am using little amount of water
But this is not necessary, I have added 1 more ball for this one
If you want to use extra quantity of dough
You can start making aheer for both ingredients
Kheer is ready and now I will add salt as per taste
In this case I am adding less than 1.5 tsp salt
once all the Kheer is cooked properly then we will make the batter for Bataka Vada
I have heated 3 spoons of oil in a nonstick pan
Put 1-1.5 tsp Cumin seeds and 1-1.5 tsp Mustard seeds
Keep the flame at low
When the Cumin & Cumin seeds get well mashed, add 1-1.5 tsp whole corns
Add a little Hing
Add 10-12 sweet lemon leaves
1⁄4 tsp Turmeric Powder
Mix everything well
Now let's add urad dal marja paste and the mixture is done Time to add the Baking Powder and the White Pepper Paste
I have added two spoon white pepper paste and only half spoon of baking powder
I added 6 red chilies to the same paste
Add the right kind of the Chilli as per your preference
The paste of this paste we have to marinate it for 1 to 1.5 minutes
After that we will mash Bafele in this manner
Now adding salt according to the taste
I have added 1tsp of salt
Adding ½ tsp Garam Masala Add 1 tsp sugar
Add 1 1⁄2 tsp Garam Masala
Add 1 1⁄2 tsp mango powder
If you don't have Mango powder, add just lemongrass
Add the lime juice to make the mango powder loose Add 1 tbsp Khand To test whether the crumb is getting tender or not add Amchur powder
Add 1 spoon Khand Add 1 spoon from the mix in order to add some sweetening substance
Since the bitter gourd has less sweetness so I am adding only 1 spoon
but you may add upto 2-3 spoons for more sourness
Add 1 cup Coriander Leaves You can add as much as 3 spoons as needed Now let's add coriander leaves
With this quantity you can make 6-7 baddaka vadas with medium sized
Mix the coriander properly and then turn off the gas
And let it cool down completely
Now that is cool down completely once it gets completely cooled so now let us prepare medium-sized fatakavada dough
you can make these kind of dough according to your personal taste
once the fatakavada dough is ready let us start making fatakas bhajiya
take a strainer so from it For this let's prepare a slice of Bhataka To make Bhataka we will need to remove skin
Remove the upper part to make the similar size slice
We would need to cut a thick slice into it
Usually we cut thin slices
But the Bhataka we get in Raipur Bhajia
have a thicker slices Like this we will find the Vataka in the Rajpur.
So we make small thick slices and cut it in half.
and then we will add it with some water to prevent the sligh from getting darker.
I have made both the Vataka slices.
Once the slices are ready, we will have some soda in a glass. Then will add a pinch of baking soda to it.
We just mix everything thoroughly.
Before adding the baking soda,
let me do the heat up.
So firstly, we will start frying the Batakah Vada .
After heating up the oil properly,
we will keep the gas flame medium and very high And we have to fry the Bataka
Firstly, we will fry the Bataka
After that in the same way we are going to prepare the fenugreek seeds
After that after one side it gets fried
Then we have to flip it
If Bataka gets fried, it will break

So we fry a little bit Then we are going to flip it If you keep stirring it for a longer period of time, theaitu or any other dish The first thing to step apart is to do so that the hot oil in the pan does not turn too hot and it does not become too thick
Bhatak Vada is already fried , so now we will take it out
I have prepared 6 Bhatak Vada of this size
Now we will make Bhataka Bhjia
In a pot, addya Add a little Soji to Kheera
The one we get in Raypur bhajiya have Soji in it

So, we will add Soji here to the Kheera and add some more soji to bring sweetness to Kheera Now, make sure that the mixture does not mix with the buttermilk mixture in the batter. When you make the batter like this, pour little amount of water in the container after pouring the batter into the container. in this fashion let it rest for 10 minutes
after 10 minutes
let's prepare the bhatak bhajiya
let it rest for 10 minutes
heat oil on medium flame
as we have kept the bhatak slices hard
it will take little more time to fry the bhatak We will fry these fritters for a little longer than the remaining space.
If you fry it in very hot oil, then the paratha will have enough of the time to cook itself.
But this is the case if the paratha is in some way dry then cook it in medium high heat.
When these fritters become slightly wilted I will turn it aside.
These fritters will take around 4-5 minutes to fry
So if you wanna make this fritter in bigger quantity
put a whistle in cooker and have it half boil
After that slice it thick
Then make fritters in larger quantity So you won't need more time once it is boiled, you have to slice it thickly and prepare the fry
then you won't need more time to prepare the fry
so, if you have large quantity
then you can make fry this way
after frying,
then we will remove it
and like this we will prepare other fillings
now we will prepare the fenugreekta we need to fry whole coriander leaves
then add some garam paste
we have to add in 2-3 pinch of bhajiya
keep the pan warm
put on a pan and add little soda
we will cook for few minutes
before frying the bhajiya
fry them with 1 tbsp oil for making the meat balls
Because our meat balls will become bitter if we fry the meat balls so we need to fry 4-5 bhajiyas
Heat a pan and put the meat ball on the other side
and put the meat ball slightly on the handle
When we prepare the meat ball, the consistency of it should be slightly thin remove mould from hand and make the mouth round to make fenugreek flat
the consistency is still little thin
and round shape
so keep them in refilled oil
and fry them
once one side is fried
flip it
it will fried in 3-4 minutes let it steam for 3-4 minutes
In our local Gota, some people add
some salt for sweetness
but here I am not adding any salt
So if you wish to have some taste of Raypoor food
then leave the Kheer without adding salt
after 3 to 4 minutes
we can now take it out
its not required when fry the jaggery
fry them on medium flame for 3 to 4 minutes
the consistency should be crispy on the outside
now our homemade Batak Vada , Methi Gota
and Bataka Bhajiya are ready
It is a really tasty Toi
and you don't need any other chutney
or ketchup
I have added it in just to go along with Marjani
If you follow the recipe from the beginning And cook the dish
then their taste will change
So try this recipe

Subscribe
